# Pagination

## How cursors work

Cursor pagination returns a `next_cursor` value with every page of results. Pass it back as the `cursor` parameter to fetch the following page, and stop when it is null. Cursors expire after 24 hours, so restart from the first page if you receive E_CURSOR_EXPIRED. Paragraph 1 covers ordering guarantee number 1.
